faq.question: Is it possible to activate an Internet package while roaming abroad?
faq.answer: Azercell allows its subscribers to activate their Internet package in roaming using SMS, USSD-code or through the “Azercell” application.

faq.question: Is it possible to purchase multiple roaming internet packages at the same time?
faq.answer: Subscriber will not be able to purchase a new roaming data pack if there is internet data remaining on the current roaming pack.

faq.question: How can I check my internet balance?
faq.answer:
To check the internet balance, it is required to send BALANS to 2525 or dial *100#YES .
It is also possible to get balance information via " Azercell " app.
Balance information for postpaid subscribers may be delayed in roaming as they are received from the external operators serving them.

faq.question: How is the internet usage calculated when the package volume is exhausted?
faq.answer: If the internet volume provided within the pack expires during the session, the service fee will be calculated according to the current tariff.

faq.question: Is the use of the roaming Internet package limited in case of two-way line closure?
faq.answer: When the subscriber line is closed unilaterally or bilaterally, the use of the roaming Internet package is automatically stopped.

faq.question: How to activate the service?
faq.answer: A foreign citizen can activate the service by applying to any Azercell Exclusive offices or our official dealers with a foreign passport.

faq.question: How to deactivate the service?
faq.answer: The service is automatically deactivated after 30 days.

faq.question: Is the service active while roaming?
faq.answer: The service is not available while roaming.

faq.question: When Travel packs cannot be activated?
faq.answer: While countrywide tariffs and packages are active, it is not possible to use Travel packs.

faq.question: During what period is it possible to use the bonuses provided within the Travel packs?
faq.answer: Bonuses can be used within 30 days.

faq.question: Are the bonuses provided within the Travel packages activated immediately?
faq.answer: Bonuses provided on packages are activated immediately.

faq.question: How is the rate determined when bonuses are used up early or expired?
What is the billing interval for calls and internet provided within the package?
faq.answer: The calculation interval within the pack is 60 seconds for calls and 51KB for internet.

faq.question: How to find balance information?
faq.answer: To find out the balance, you need to call 2112 or send an empty SMS to the same number.

faq.question: How to activate roaming?
faq.answer:
To activate roaming:
Postpaid subscribers can send SMS with the keyword START to 8808 . The cost of each SMS to 8808 is 0.01 AZN.
Prepaid subscribers can dial *135*1#YES .

faq.question: Where can I find information about roaming tariffs?
faq.answer: To get information about tariffs, enter the name of the country you are going to travel in the search section at the top of the page.

faq.question: What precautions should be taken to avoid roaming issues before traveling?
faq.answer:
Check whether Azercell has a roaming partnership with a telecom operator in the destination country before you travel.
If you are a postpaid subscriber, ensure that there are no outstanding charges on your account. To check the number balance, it is required to call or send an empty (blank) SMS to 650 . The price for incoming SMS from 650 is 0.02 AZN.

faq.question: How to top-up the balance while abroad?
faq.answer:
The following Azercell services can be used to top up the balance while abroad:
Online payment
Scratch cards

faq.question: What are the rules for making calls in roaming?
faq.answer:
To make a call while roaming, use the international dialing format:
[+] [country code] [city code / mobile operator code] [number].

faq.question: How to call the Customer Care Center in roaming?
Which actions should be taken if the internet is not working in roaming?
How do I deactivate Roaming?
faq.answer:
Postpaid subscribers can send SMS with the keyword STOP to 8808 . The cost of each SMS sent to 8808 is 0.01 AZN.
Prepaid subscribers need to dial *135*0#YES .
